name: qfd_hub_ps-dde873a8e-tc-bal32
purpose: Owner-approved layout-only balanced manual map (alternating32pin M4/M6 groups, uniformly spaced within ORIGINAL face intervals). Full-shape PSP production-generator legal map PASS5270 pins, densityM4 8.02/M6 7.68bits/um, no dup/outside/overlap. Zero cycles/area delta; unchanged RTL, timing/link budgets. bench.name: hub_exact
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/bench && iverilog -g2012 -o {RUN}/bench/hb0 -P tb_qwen_die_hub.PS=1 -P tb_qwen_die_hub.NEG=0 rtl/test/tb_qwen_die_hub.sv rtl/physical/ot_qwen_die_hub.sv rtl/physical/ot_qwen_die_cdc_ch.sv rtl/lib/ot_async_fifo.sv rtl/lib/ot_reset_sync.sv && vvp -n {RUN}/bench/hb0 | tee {RUN}/bench/hb0.log && grep -q '^PASS' {RUN}/bench/hb0.log

bench.name: hub_neg
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/bench && iverilog -g2012 -o {RUN}/bench/hb1 -P tb_qwen_die_hub.PS=1 -P tb_qwen_die_hub.NEG=1 rtl/test/tb_qwen_die_hub.sv rtl/physical/ot_qwen_die_hub.sv rtl/physical/ot_qwen_die_cdc_ch.sv rtl/lib/ot_async_fifo.sv rtl/lib/ot_reset_sync.sv && vvp -n {RUN}/bench/hb1 | tee {RUN}/bench/hb1.log && grep -q '^PASS' {RUN}/bench/hb1.log

calibrate.reason: die-context IO is referenced IN-RUN to this block's own propagated clock (io_ref_skew.sdc measures the boundary-register arrival after CTS and re-applies at GRT/DRT/FILL), so no calibrated insertion feeds the SDC; no Qwen budget sheet exists (asked the die-top agent)

route.cmd: export OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 OT_PIN_BALANCE_H='M4 M6' OT_PIN_BALANCE_V='M5 M7'; export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; PIN_H='M4 M6' PIN_V='M5 M7' HM=0.010 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/qwen_die_masters/signoff/qfd_hub_ps.sdc' SRC={SRC} bash physical/qwen_die_masters/jobs/route_master.sh qfd_hub_ps {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/hbm_fmax_attn_abstract.py --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --name qfd_hub --out {RUN}/record/views/qfd_hub --image openroad/orfs:asap7lock  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: no Qwen r21 budget sheet; masters kit budgets (0.2 T outside + 90 ps intra / 150 ps inter-region, hold 50) applied in-run
